title: Delicious Cilantro Chicken Salad
description: This delicious cilantro chicken salad recipe is tasty and seasoned with fresh chopped cilantro, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, and poultry seasoning.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, or more as needed
2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, or more to taste, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon garlic powder, plus more to taste
1 pinch poultry seasoning, or more to taste
kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup slivered almonds, or to taste
1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, or more to taste
2 squeezes lime juice, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add chicken. Season with garlic powder, poultry seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Cook until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.

Add celery, red onion, and almonds to the bowl. Stir in mayonnaise, cilantro, cumin, chili powder, and lime juice. Season with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Add more mayonnaise if salad seems too dry.
Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Serve chilled.
